notes: Timetable cell descriptions are preserved as source text; lab groups and faculty details may be embedded in the activity string.
Empty periods are represented as activity=null and type=free.
The sections object retains the sample's normalized timetable structure for VA, VB, and VC.
raw_sheets contains non-empty cell values from all 12 workbook sheets, including timetable sheets, master timetables, faculty timetables, and load-allocation sheets.
In raw_sheets, values are keyed by Excel column letter and row number so source positions are preserved; blank cells are omitted.
